title: Esthetic bugs on version 3.0.0.1 graph
body:
On version 3.0.0.1 (master) I experience two bugs regarding the displayed graph:
1. Last reading displayed on top but not on graph:
![Screenshot_20220404-160541_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/93551840/161555182-b1f2732c-2238-471a-8d84-4d1282a4060b.jpg)
![Screenshot_20220402-160719_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/93551840/161555187-40a355fd-d62d-409a-bae4-64fe11aaf609.jpg)
2. More rarely, there is just a part of the graph displayed (the most updated part):
![Screenshot_20220316-081245_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/93551840/161555372-6a1ff9ed-7c09-4717-9d48-2e980f30a1fa.jpg)
*Both those problems are resolved by switching the graph all the way to 24hr and back to 3hr view.
